_comment: Which host each API key variable is allowed to reach, and in which role. Generated once from
providers.json and judges.json on 2026-09-07 and kept by hand from then on.
WHY A SEPARATE FILE. The contribution gate binds a key variable to one host and one role, but it
used to rebuild that binding from providers.json on every run - so a pull request that SWAPPED two
existing providers' URLs, key variables untouched, produced zero findings and would have sent
every runner's key for one provider to the other. The binding has to be written down somewhere
the pull request cannot rewrite as a side effect of the change it makes. This is that place.
- every provider or judge that names a key_env must have a line here with the SAME host and role;
- every line here must be used by a provider or judge, so the file cannot rot;
- adding a provider means adding its line in the same pull request, where a reviewer sees both;
- changing a host here is the one edit that moves a credential, and it is never routine.
role is `provider` (a free-tier key, benchmarked) or `judge` (a paid key that scores the jury).
The two never share a variable or a host.
